description:
What could have prevented thousands of deaths? Dr. Pierre Kory weighs in on the use of repurposed drugs discovered to be effective against Covid and answers why they were used so widely around the world but not in the US, Canada, Europe or Australia.Show more Dr. Paul Marik testifies that there is nothing new about treating a disease with repurposed drugs; 40% of all drugs are used off-label. Why would we treat Covid differently? "The FDA, the CDC, the NIH does not want you to use an off-label drug to treat Coronovirus because it would compete with Big Pharma." - Dr. Paul Marik
Dr. Marik also describes what he has seen with treating Covid patients with Remdesivir in hospitals.
Sen. Ron Johnson Roundtable Discussion: Covid-19 Vaccines: What They Are, How They Work and Possible Causes of Injuries. December 7, 2022
